candidate_relations.reason: The long-standing segmental stony induration with hypertrichosis, minimal fibroblast increase extending into subcutis, adipocyte entrapment, preserved appendages, absent inflammation, and increased dermal CD34 supports segmental stiff skin syndrome rather than morphea.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Alternative localized sclerosing dermatosis and key differential, not segmental stiff skin syndrome.
